title: First access
description: Enter the administrator details and the bootstrap token provided at deployment to create the company's first access.
unavailable: First access could not be completed. Check the data and the token, then try again.
resetDescription: Enter your username. If it exists, we send a code to the registered contact.
resetCodeSent: If the username exists, the code is on its way to the registered contact. It is valid for 15 minutes.
resetRejected: Could not finish the reset. Check the code and the password and try again.
resetDone: Password changed. You can sign in with the new password.

users.title: System users
users.intro: Who signs in to this installation, with which roles, and where the invitation is delivered. Accounts are created disabled: the person receives a code and chooses their own password.
users.empty: No user besides your own account.
users.forbidden: Only accounts that manage users can see this list. Ask a company administrator for the permission.
users.resendSucceeded: Invitation resent. The previous code no longer works.

inviteDialog.title: Invite user
inviteDialog.intro: The account starts disabled and without a password. The activation code is sent through the chosen channel.
inviteDialog.name: Full name
inviteDialog.rolesHint: At least one role. The role decides what the person can see.
inviteDialog.taxIdHint: Optional. With a Driver or Aggregate role, it is what finds the fleet record.
inviteDialog.channelHint: How the activation code is delivered.
inviteDialog.contactField: This is where the invitation goes.

editDialog.title: Edit user
editDialog.name: Full name
editDialog.usernameHint: Lowercase, no spaces or accents; dot, hyphen and underscore are accepted.
editDialog.usernameInvalid: Login outside the accepted format: 3 to 60 characters, starting with a letter or digit.
editDialog.contactHint: The stored contact is masked in the list; fill this only to replace it.
editDialog.contactRequired: Changing the channel requires the matching contact.
editDialog.emailHint: This is the login e-mail. Changing it requires verification again and does not change the invitation channel.
editDialog.rolesHint: The role list is replaced entirely by whatever is checked here.

removeDialog.title: Remove the account
removeDialog.warning: The company membership is dropped and the person loses access to this installation. The history of what they recorded is preserved.

errors.default: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
errors.COMPANY_USERS_FORBIDDEN: Your account does not manage users for this company.
errors.COMPANY_USERS_REQUEST_FAILED: The API did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
errors.COMPANY_USERS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The API answered in an unexpected format.
errors.COMPANY_USER_NOT_FOUND: This user no longer belongs to the company. Refresh the list.
errors.COMPANY_USER_CONTACT_TAKEN: An account with this contact already exists.
errors.IDENTITY_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND: The account has no identity in the login provider. Invite the person again.
errors.SELF_MEMBERSHIP_REMOVAL: Nobody removes their own account. Ask another administrator.
errors.COMPANY_USER_TAX_ID_TAKEN: An account with this tax id already exists.

fleetLink.linked: Linked to the existing fleet record.
fleetLink.noDriverRecord: Invitation sent, but no fleet record matches this tax id — create the record so the person shows up in the fleet.

sync.title: Keycloak reconciliation
sync.intro: Who exists here, who exists in the login provider, and who exists on one side only. Divergence never shows in the list above — it shows here.
sync.allLinked: Every account exists on both sides.
sync.divergentCount: {{count}} account(s) exist on one side only.
sync.truncated: Keycloak holds more accounts than this page fetched — divergence may exist outside it.

bulk.selectAll: Select every row on this page
bulk.addsOnly: Roles are added. Whoever already has one keeps it, and nothing is removed.
